title: Grateful Dead Live at Eagle's Auditorium on 1968-01-27
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > PCM > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Decent soundboard capture of the lone Spanish Jam – solid guitar fireworks but uneven audio and mixed enthusiasm.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board tape of just the Spanish Jam from the early‑68 Seattle dates, with generally clear sound though a bit choppy and some feedback that dulls the mix. Listeners are split: some praise the wild guitar improvisation while others find it uninspired compared to other jams from the era.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews average around 3‑4 stars; sound quality is acceptable but limited to one track, and opinions on the performance are divided, leading to a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall fine soundboard capture, but some listeners note feedback that hurts the guitar tone and a slightly choppy texture; bass is unusually high in the mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only a single jam is present, likely from the end of the show; its exact placement and surrounding set are uncertain.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar work described as a crazy, wicked jam though some note feedback that dulls it.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is reported to sit very high in the mix and be quite prominent.
